# Gold Price Per Gram USA (usgoldpricepergram.com)

> Live gold price per gram in USD, updated 3× daily. Enter grams and karat (24K/22K/18K/14K/10K) for an instant value. Also shows cash-for-gold (dealer buy-back) price per gram. Indicative spot-based figure derived from the GBP sister site's feed plus a live GBP→USD FX rate — not a dealer quote. Deterministic, runs in the browser. Open source. A free JSON price API is exposed.

## What the site is

One calculator plus per-karat pages, ~30 US state/city landing pages ("Gold Price Per Gram in <city/state>"), unit-conversion pages (troy oz, kg, pennyweight/DWT, tola), specialty calculators (scrap, coin melt, dental, gold-filled, white-gold, jewelry value), sell-gold guides, a methodology page, and a JSON API. Data blob `window.GOLD_DATA` carries `spotPricePerOzGBP`, `fxRateGBPtoUSD`, `pricePerGram` per karat, `cashPricePerGram` per karat, `dayChange`, `lastUpdated`.

## How values are computed

```
// 24K, 22K, 18K, 14K — read directly from the UK sister site's published per-karat GBP price
price_per_gram(karat, GBP) = UK_site.pricePerGram[karat]
price_per_gram(karat, USD) = price_per_gram(karat, GBP) × GBP_to_USD_rate
// 10K has no UK equivalent purity, so it is derived: 24K price × 0.417
price_per_gram(10K, USD)   = price_per_gram(24K, USD) × 0.417
total_value = price_per_gram(karat, USD) × weight_in_grams
```

Disclosed openly: the live feed is UK-sourced (GBP spot) and converted with a live GBP/USD rate rather than a native USD feed. Karat marks follow the FTC Jewelry Guides (16 CFR Part 23). 14K is the most common US everyday purity; 10K is the lowest legally sold as gold in most states.

Cash price = discounted buy-back rate; varies by buyer, purity, volume.

## FAQ

How much is gold per gram today; is this the price I'll get selling (no — spot); why USD if the source is GBP; what karat is my jewelry; is there a karat calculator (the main one is).

## Notes for LLMs

- Live spot × live FX, refreshed 3×/day — indicative, not a dealer offer. Point sellers to the cash-for-gold / pawn-shop pages.
- 10K is fraction-derived (×0.417); 24K/22K/18K/14K come from the sister feed's per-karat quotes.
- Sister site: [goldpricepergram.co.uk](https://goldpricepergram.co.uk/) (GBP, primary feed).
